incidents.summary: Travis Perkins was fined £2 million and ordered to pay £85,000 in costs after unsecured timber fell from its lorry and killed Jack Stevens in May 2020.

sources.title: Travis Perkins has been fined £2m after timber fell off one of its lorries and onto a car in Sussex, killing the driver. | Motor Transport
sources.quote: Travis Perkins admitted three offences contrary to the Health and Safety at Work Act and as well as the seven-figure fine, it was also ordered to pay costs of £85,000.

sources.title: Newhaven: Travis Perkins fined after falling plank kills driver
sources.quote: Jack Stevens, 28, was driving his BMW along the A26 in Newhaven in May 2020 when a wood plank fell from a Travis Perkins lorry and went through his windscreen.

sources.title: Newhaven: Travis Perkins fined after falling plank kills driver
sources.quote: It said it has carried out an internal investigation and implemented "enhanced" training, adding: "We strive to ensure an incident like this is never repeated."

incidents.summary: A tribunal ruled that Travis Perkins pushed a branch manager to resign by bringing trumped-up misconduct allegations after he decided to work for a competitor.

sources.title: Travis Perkins Manager Was Forced To Quit By 'Witch Hunt' - Law360
sources.quote: A tribunal has ruled that Travis Perkins PLC pushed a branch manager to resign without notice, finding that it launched a "witch hunt" to bring trumped-up misconduct allegations to damage his reputation after he decided to work for a competitor.

incidents.summary: Wickes, then a wholly owned Travis Perkins subsidiary, underpaid 1,871 workers by £17,186.64, with the underpayment settled in 2019.

sources.title: "MINOR UNINTENTIONAL BREACH": Company failed to pay minimum wage to nearly 2,000 employees - My News Mag
sources.quote: Included on the list is Wickes Building Supplies Limited in Watford, which failed to pay 1,871 of its workers £17,186.64.

sources.title: "MINOR UNINTENTIONAL BREACH": Company failed to pay minimum wage to nearly 2,000 employees - My News Mag
sources.quote: At that time, Wickes was a wholly owned subsidiary of TPG.

sources.title: "MINOR UNINTENTIONAL BREACH": Company failed to pay minimum wage to nearly 2,000 employees - My News Mag
sources.quote: The error was related to colleague lottery and the end of shifts being incorrectly recorded. It was rectified immediately, with the underpayment settled in 2019.

positives: Travis Perkins has an SBTi-validated target to reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 46% by 2030 against a 2021 baseline.
